title: Spain Beats France 2-0 in Dallas to Reach First World Cup Final Since 2010
detail: Mikel Oyarzabal converted a 22nd-minute penalty and Pedro Porro added a second in the 58th as Spain beat France 2-0 at Dallas Stadium in the tournament's first semifinal. Spain has now conceded only one goal across seven matches -- to Belgium in the quarterfinals -- the tournament's stingiest defensive run. It is Spain's first World Cup final appearance since winning the title in 2010.

media.caption: Spain beat France 2-0 in Dallas to reach the World Cup final
